Kite administrator recovery

Recover the admin account for NYCMC/COMPASS.

Your password stays in this browser. This helper prepares a database command; only someone signed in to the existing Neon database can apply it. It does not grant access or reset a password by itself.

Apply the reset

  1. Copy the command below.
  2. Open the existing production SQL editor.
  3. Replace the editor contents, paste the command and click Run.
  4. After it succeeds, log in to Kite with user ID admin and your new password.

If copying fails, select the command and copy it manually. Keep this command private; it contains a password hash. Existing admin sessions will be revoked when it runs.
